mapper.select:
SELECT A.NATION_CODE , A.ITEM_CODE , B.ITEM_NAME , B.HS_CODE , A.FTA_HS_CODE , A.REMARKS FROM FTA_HS_CODE A INNER JOIN ITEM_MST B ON A.COMPANY_CODE= B.COMPANY_CODE AND A.ITEM_CODE = B.ITEM_CODE WHERE A.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND A.NATION_CODE = #{nationCode}
AND A.ITEM_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchItemCode} ,'%')
AND A.FTA_HS_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchHsCode} ,'%')
ORDER BY A.ITEM_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO FTA_HS_CODE (ITEM_CODE, COMPANY_CODE, NATION_CODE, FTA_HS_CODE, REMARKS, CREATE_DATE, CREATE_BY, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_BY) VALUES (#{item_code}, #{company_code}, #{nation_code}, #{fta_hs_code}, #{remarks}, NOW(), #{update_by}, NOW(), #{update_by})
